cards.text: Zechariah the prophet (Zechariah 1:1) has been seeing visions, with an angel there to talk him through them, and he just saw a gold lampstand (Zechariah 4:1-2). Now he looks up again and sees a scroll, and it's FLYING. Friend, the only thing that flies in my bakery is sprinkles when I crank the mixer too high.

cards.question: The angel asks Zechariah what he sees, and he describes the flying scroll. The scroll is small enough to hold in one hand.

cards.text: Twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. Friend, this isn't a scroll, it's a BILLBOARD with a pilot's license.

cards.question: The angel says the flying scroll is the ___ going out over the face of all the land, and wrongdoers will be removed.

cards.text: One side of the scroll says every thief will be removed. Front AND back, friend, this scroll does NOT waste paper.

cards.question: One side of the flying scroll says every thief will be removed. Who does the other side say will be removed?

answers.text: Everyone who works on the Sabbath

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts says the curse will enter the house of the thief and the house of the one who swears falsely by His name. Once it gets inside, it stays there.
The curse moves into the house and stays. What does it do to that house?

answers.text: Destroys it down to its timbers and stones
Marks its door so everyone will know
Hands it over to a brand new owner

cards.text: Then the angel tells Zechariah to look up and see what's approaching, and Zechariah asks what it is. After a flying billboard, I bet he's not ruling ANYTHING out.

cards.question: The angel tells Zechariah what’s going forth. What is it?

cards.text: Then the angel adds, "This is their iniquity in all the land."
And behold, the cover of lead is raised, and there's a woman sitting inside the basket. Friend, I spent YEARS in the dark of a junk drawer, but at least my drawer didn't have a LEAD lid.

cards.question: The angel tells Zechariah who the woman in the basket is: “This is ___,” he said.
The angel tells Zechariah the woman in the basket is Wickedness. What does the angel do with her next?

answers.text: Shoves her down and shuts the lead cover
Lets her climb out and walk away free
Hands the basket over to Zechariah

cards.text: Then Zechariah looks up again and sees two women approaching, with the wind in their wings, wings like a stork's. Meanwhile I get around by hopping, and this gold base comes with me EVERY single time.

cards.question: The two winged women come to the basket with Wickedness inside. What do they do with it?

answers.text: Lift it up between heaven and earth
Drop it down into the deep sea
Set it down by the temple gate

cards.text: Now the basket's up in the air, and Zechariah asks the angel where they're taking it. Friend, if Wickedness is flying off in a basket, I want the forwarding address TOO.

cards.question: The angel says the two women are taking the basket to the land of ___.

cards.text: The angel says a house will be built for it there, and when it's ready, the basket will be set on its pedestal. Zechariah's night of visions isn't over yet, friend, so keep that oven warm.
